scope: existing NOX OneHost and ready WEB Resonance only

components.name: rclone
components.use: Existing Drive or owner PC SFTP remote, immutable copy and streaming readback; do not create public storage

components.name: PyTorch CUDA SM70
components.use: Real FP16 CUDA smoke and existing engine benchmark before any replacement

components.name: DeepSpeed
components.use: Verify built CPUAdam/optimizer paths, compare ZeRO/offload against measured baseline

components.name: Transformers/Accelerate/Datasets/Safetensors
components.use: Reuse installed environment; freeze exact versions and wheel hashes before staged changes

components.name: PEFT LoRA and merge
components.use: Train only against the exact student revision and tokenizer; merge only after holdout and checkpoint restoration

components.name: bitsandbytes 8-bit optimizer or NF4/FP4
components.use: Linux CUDA12 build including sm70; LLM.int8 requires CC7.5 and is not the V100 path

components.name: existing llama.cpp CUDA inference
components.use: Prompt cache, supported KV formats, batching, thread counts and actual SSE TTFT/tokens per second; inspect existing PIDs before stopping anything

components.name: PyTorch data pipeline
components.use: Pinned buffers, persistent workers, bounded prefetch, tokenization caching, length bucketing and gradient accumulation

components.name: psutil and nvidia-ml-py
components.use: Existing GPU Resource Brain telemetry; cgroup RAM, STOP, restart backoff, no competing scheduler

components.name: S03 semantic retrieval
components.use: Optional compatible extension only if needed; same S03, bounded parallel retrieval, no duplicate memory database

components.name: C01-C08/M0-M7/Reflection/Self-model
components.use: Grounded facts, provenance, bounded context and real conversation tests; a package install is not proof of intelligence or consciousness

components.name: third-party adapters and new teacher weights
components.use: No random consciousness/emotion adapters. Verify architecture, base revision, tokenizer, license, holdout and actual measured benefit before acquiring large files

storage_layout.hot: active chat model and active training state stay local
storage_layout.warm: bounded RAM cache with cgroup reserve; cache is not backup
storage_layout.cold: verified inactive model objects on an existing authorized Drive or PC storage
storage_layout.eviction: only after byte-level remote readback, current explicit inactive inventory and shared native writer lease; never S03, active model, unique checkpoints or sole backups
